title: async SQLAlchemy runtime dependency is absent
detail: A clean pip install -e '.[test]' cannot run Alembic: SQLAlchemy raises ValueError: the greenlet library is required. Neither greenlet nor sqlalchemy[asyncio] is declared

title: “deferred” HNSW migration is the Alembic head
detail: ScriptDirectory.get_current_head() returns 0002, not 0001. A live alembic upgrade head applied 0002 and created both indexes. The operational command documented by the decision cannot keep 0002 unapplied

title: digest source URLs are not enforced
detail: send_digest() persists model prose containing a quote with no URL, despite INV-10

title: empty and truncated digest responses are persisted
detail: A response with no text blocks becomes a header-only digest. A response ending with stop_reason="max_tokens" is also persisted as complete

title: persisted cluster IDs can disagree with digest prose
detail: gather_digest_input() ranks clusters for the model, then send_digest() independently ranks them again for persistence. A ranking change between calls stores IDs that did not produce the digest

title: an accepted enrichment batch can become untracked
detail: If Anthropic accepts a batch and the following enrichment_batches insert fails, the batch ID is neither persisted nor logged. Recovery is impossible and the next tick can resubmit the same posts

title: one malformed HN timestamp aborts a query
detail: Missing, non-ISO, and non-string created_at values escape _hit_to_row. The exception prevents the already-collected page rows from reaching the final upsert

title: one Reddit submission failure loses later posts
detail: Comment expansion errors are only isolated at the subreddit level. A bad first submission aborts iteration and prevents later valid submissions and accumulated rows from being persisted

title: recluster_all() cannot clear clusters
detail: Live PostgreSQL rejects TRUNCATE clusters RESTART IDENTITY because enriched_signals.cluster_id has a foreign-key constraint. Nulling values first does not remove the table-level dependency

title: compose exposes stateful services on all interfaces
detail: PostgreSQL and Redis publish default ports without a loopback host binding; PostgreSQL also uses public development credentials. On a shared/LAN-connected workstation this exposes both services beyond the intended local validation runtime

title: malformed log level crashes worker startup
detail: Whitespace or an unknown LOG_LEVEL reaches logging.basicConfig as an invalid string and raises ValueError before the worker starts

title: manual quality acceptance still needs a human path
detail: No proxy assertions were invented for pain-point normalization, vertical disagreements, or digest usefulness. Those acceptance criteria require reading actual model output

clean async dependency installation
detail: sqlalchemy[asyncio] installs greenlet in a new environment, and Alembic connects without an ad-hoc package install

title: safe default migration and opt-in index mechanics
detail: Default head is 0001 with zero HNSW indexes. The deferred config sees 0002 and creates exactly two cosine indexes. The stale Validator path is fixed

title: deferred revision breaks later normal deployments
detail: After the opt-in command records revision 0002, the next normal alembic upgrade head exits 255: Can't locate revision identified by '0002'. Hiding 0002 from the default ScriptDirectory also makes the default deployment path unable to understand databases that have legitimately applied it

title: deferred HNSW creation blocks writes
detail: Both indexes use plain CREATE INDEX inside Alembic's transaction. The installed PostgreSQL/pgvector supports CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY; use Alembic's autocommit block, or explicitly enforce a maintenance window. The current migration does neither

title: one linked quote masks an unlinked quote
detail: validate_model_output() accepts a digest containing one quote with a URL and a second quote without one because _URL_RE.search(prose) is aggregate. INV-10 requires every quote to carry its own source URL

title: other digest recovery contracts hold
detail: Empty/whitespace output, max_tokens, and output with no URL are rejected before any DB row, file, or SMTP attempt. Valid linked output passes. Prompt and persisted cluster IDs come from the same ranking

title: accepted batch ID remains recoverable
detail: Tracking-persistence failure logs the accepted Anthropic batch ID at ERROR and re-raises

title: Reddit and HN isolate malformed third-party data
detail: All three Reddit failure domains preserve partial progress. HN timestamp parsing drops unusable values and attaches UTC to a naive ISO timestamp

title: reclustering is FK-safe and preserves embeddings
detail: Live PostgreSQL accepts the DELETE-based clear, cluster memberships become null before reassignment, and stored embeddings remain unchanged

title: Compose and worker hardening hold
detail: PostgreSQL/Redis binds are loopback-only. Log levels normalize padding/case and safely fall back to INFO for unknown and numeric strings

title: manual quality acceptance remains human-owned
